integrity: All-dimensional inequalities proved analytically; finite exact-rational and numerical geometry checks are supplementary. No external independent certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-antipodal-corner slab family, integer dimension at least three, depth from zero to two. Prior published dimension-four local product formula is credited. The 2026-10-07 cube-apex preprint was available at abstract level only, leaving residual priority uncertainty.
title: A dimension-six transition in the Mahler-maximizing truncation of two antipodal cube corners
